main_scientific_conclusion: End the current fixed balanced-data recipe. C is bounded by F=17<24, with additional failure-family shortages simple0<9, clean2<6, heat1<2 and neutral-family shortage twoS2<3. These necessary upper bounds fail even before unknown teacher outcomes, later common Q and deduplication can reduce candidate sets.
